prompt.instruction: BABILong task instruction (per-task few-shot prompt; verbatim strings in the harness scripts referenced in PROVENANCE.md)
prompt.post_prompt: Always return your answer in the following format: $entity$ is in the $location$. Do not write anything else after that.
prompt.pipeline_note: Sapience memory pipeline: the full-length input is ingested into a structured memory store at write time; {evidence} is the retrieved event set (~600-1000 reader-input tokens at every scale), NOT the raw context. The reader model (claude-sonnet-4-5) never sees the raw haystack. See METHOD.md.
